nom: Rael Miracle Clear Soothing Spot Gel

avis.texte: i dont have cystic acne or anything crazy, just the occasional pimples. this made absolutely zero difference in my skin and my breakouts. it didnt even decrease redness- nothing. i used jt for a month consistently. giving two stars beacause the applicator and push pen are a genius idea!

avis.titre: Works good but application is annoying
avis.texte: This works very well for helping to reduce inflammation, especially for a just-popped-pimple, and i would have given 5 stars... however, using the pen is obnoxious. You have to click the pen and it takes 1-2 min for ANY product to come out- and unless your just covering 1 tiny pimple, you have to repeat this process several times, totaling 4-6 mins to cover a few spots on your face. I dont always have that much time to sit around and wait like that therefore I dont reach for this as often as I would otherwise.

avis.titre: This works the best for me!
avis.texte: I am shocked at how well this works. Reduces the size of a pimple overnight!

avis.titre: A Lifesaver for Breakouts—My Brother Swears By It
avis.texte: He's tried a bunch of products before, but this is the one he keeps reaching for. It's become part of his daily routine, and he loves how lightweight and effective it is. If you're looking for something that actually works without being harsh, this spot gel is worth trying.
The Rael Spot Gel works quickly to reduce redness and shrink pimples overnight. It's lightweight, non-greasy, and doesn't irritate my skin. A must-have for clearing stubborn spots fast!

avis.titre: Haven't even used it but possibly defective?
avis.texte: I just got this product and I noticed when I opened it the gel continues to keep coming out without me pushing the bottom clicker. I hope it doesn't all run out I was really excited to use this but let down a little
Out of all my spot treatments this is the one i reach for the most! I havent ever gotten and irritation with this product and never had to reach for a pimple patch after using it either!

I get breakouts occasionally (more times than not) and the circles are only good for me in the evening when I wear no makeup. But when I have to work, which is everyday, and I need coverage, I wear makeup. So when I have a breakout, I use this after washing my face and before my moisturizer. It defintkely does the job.

avis.titre: Perfect for my extra sensitive skin.
avis.texte: My skin never used to have too many issues, and if i had a spot appearing i would use something like tea tree oil. That recently became too sensitive for my skin, and this has saved my skin from getting too irritated and works wonders.

I was initially on the fence and about to return this product after a few days of use. Personally, I wasn't sure if it was doing anything. However, I noticed that it was doing what it said it would do: address and help reduce acne at the early stages. Since using it, I haven't had any early stage acne turn into whiteheads at all. And some places like my forehead actually has the acne eliminated.

When my miracle clear ran out and I was waiting to gather a bigger Rael order together, I really missed not having it on hand for my blemishes. I felt...naked or ill equipped to handle whatever my face threw at me and somehow felt it threw more stuff at me during that time. This time around I bought two to prevent such a reoccurrence.
This product is easy to apply on pimples and really isn't too harsh. I love this k-beauty brand and this product has definitely helped my pimples.
Great product and easy to travel with! It works so well at relieving inflammation too! Such a soothing product.

I really like this spot gel for stopping pimples. As soon as I feel one brewing under the surface, I dab some of this gel on it and usually, it's smaller by the next day. I love the applicator and how the gel comes out of the tip to go on easily without any mess and without having to touch anything with your fingers. Plus the fact that it goes anywhere is super convenient.
Perfect blemish zapper for delicate or mature skin! Very gentle, yet the zit disappears in a day or two. So glad I tried this product :-)
I like the idea of this product but all in all, if it jams, the product doesn't come out and it's a waste. The formula is good, but wouldn't purchase again.
Worked well, calmed the spot on my face down and make up went over it easily.

I love this soothing gel, it definitely provides relief to sore breakout spots and the applicator is awesome, it worked well for me. It doesn't soothe redness in the longterm like dark spots but provides relief during the inflammation stage!
Gel works great on my spots that are starting to comein. I've had great results in making it dissapear.
It shrinks my cystic hormonal pimples. It literally shrunk it over night and took most of the redness away

I'm 42 and recently began using a hormonal IUD which caused acne like I was a teenager! Not cute! These products have saved my skin. Not only do they help clear the acne, but quality of my skin has drastically improved.
Seems to work great and I love you don't have to apply it with your fingers.

The pen is very convenient and the application goes on really smooth. The gel becomes transparent so it's barely noticeable. Unfortunately it doesn't do much for me in terms of reducing redness or making acne go away but everyone's skin is different! I wish it had worked for me because it's great otherwise.

I used this spot gel twice a day and it greatly reduced or got rid of my blemishes quickly. The only reason I put 4 stars is because I wish it came in a bigger applicator or larger/different packaging as I used it up very quickly.
Really is a miracle! Soothes redness within an hour. Blemish is gone or drastically reduced within 2 days.

I love how sleek and easygoing the packaging is. I typically pack this in my on the go bag so I can apply this whenever I see the slightest spot pop up. The product is shaped like a marker so it fits easily anywhere. The product itself comes out clear so it is undetectable when applied which is why it is perfect for on the go. I also find that there's not really a scent to the product so it's perfect for me since I have sensitive skin. It's entertaining to click the top to dispense product so overall I love it and would repurchase.
